scientific_boundaries: Stage1 manual comparison uses prediction and matching physical endpoint,both in T1 colours. Manual left panel is not labelled input.
Stage2 rawT/L adaptation updates the whole denoiser and retains T replay. The pretrained reference has a colour-domain mismatch;visual improvement is not isolated physical-dynamics improvement.
Stage3 observed-history images are independent one-step predictions,not open-loop forecasts. C and B are seen-validation;O is a training diagnostic.
O,C,X,B,L are exposed representative shapes;T remains a reference. Unseen-shape prediction is a goal,not a demonstrated result.
Long-rollout error is illustrated. Limited coverage is a hypothesis,not a demonstrated sole cause. Setting this route aside follows the owner research narrative.
